item.tib: dbang shi ri log gis sgron me bdud rtsi sdugs pa
item.coloph: shi ri log dbang gis sgrom na'i [~sgron me'i] bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di ni gshen gyi drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis sman ri'i [---] khrod du sbyar ba'o …
item.note: this is an initiation ritual. a lineage is given on fols. 26-27, ending in the author. there are illustrations on pp. 507-509. the text from pp. 510 through 512 has the following title (difficult to read): drag po rdzob lags len ma rigs mun sel yid kyis 'dod 'jo. the author is undoubtedly the prolific writer who founded sman-ri monastery, whose dates are 1356-1415. he often has the epithet gshen-gyi drang-srong, which tells us he was a monk from the gshen family.
